artifact.summary: Abstained. The abstract only gives asymptotic scaling relations (hop failure amplitude O(1/sqrt(N)), runtime O(sqrt(N)) versus O(N)). It specifies no walk operator, barrier model, coin structure, oracle, or step count, so any circuit would be an invented construction rather than a reconstruction.
